facts.after: The compiler folds now.getXxx expressions against its fixed UTC time.
facts.before: The filter compiler does not fold the new now date accessor expressions.
conditions: The current time is fixed for one compilation; a compiled statement does not update itself later.
The accessors accept no timezone argument and operate only on timestamp fields.
getMonth, getDayOfMonth, getDayOfWeek, and getDayOfYear use zero-based values; getDate uses one-based values.
facts.mechanism: The parser converts the accessor result into a literal before it renders the comparison.

facts.after: Two literal operands can produce a constant condition.
facts.before: The reviewed constant-comparison branches are absent.
conditions: Numeric literals widen to float64 for the comparison.
Strings support ordered and equality comparisons; booleans support equality and inequality.
Unsupported literal combinations return an error.
The change adds source tests and filter documentation.
facts.mechanism: The compiler swaps a left literal and a right field, then mirrors ordered operators.

limits: The preparation executes no filter test or database query.
The reports are authored experiment fixtures. No Culler Worker, Verifier, or Scribe executed this task.
